name: com.igp.custom-unity-cli
description: A zero-configuration, offline-friendly command line interface for the Unity Editor. Ships a single Editor worker package plus a dependency-free PowerShell entry point: a file-queue job system drives Unity from the terminal, CI or an AI agent without ports, servers, MCP or per-project configuration. Targets Unity 2022; Unity 6 projects should use Unity's own CLI instead.
